findings.title: Original dataset denominator is not enforced at shared market/cash input boundary
findings.detail: check_cash accepts dataset.original_n=2 or original_path_count=2 with arrays retaining only one path, then returns original_path_count=1 and qualification verified. _market_arrays ignores both declarations; check_market additionally checks only original_path_count, not the canonical original_n produced by market_dataset. A truncated saved path set can therefore be treated as its own complete population.
findings.recommendation: At shared dataset-array boundary verify canonical original_n and any original_path_count alias agree with raw prices shape; also verify cell original_n/original_path_count when supplied. Preserve failure rows instead of allowing a sliced finite subset. Add tamper tests for both aliases in market/cash.

findings.title: One shared global driver may declare conflicting global grid lengths
findings.detail: Four rows with one global_driver_id are accepted when three use global_steps=768/start704/stop768/factor64 and the fourth uses global_steps=1536/start1408/stop1536/factor128. All sliced calendar dates match, but the same global driver identity cannot have two array lengths. Current original_n equality alone does not bind the shared calendar.
findings.recommendation: Bind common global_steps and original_n for the declared shared global driver; keep legitimate per-date start/stop and aggregation changes explicit, and reject conflicting global grid lengths. Add a proportional-calendar tamper regression.

limits: This review does not qualify the formal pilot, finance accuracy, earlier SDE generation, runtime expenses, source closure, NN fitting, validation choice or final adoption.

Teacher label replay always uses sixteen IID blocks and therefore rejects N=1 even when all requested thresholds are exact-linear. Formal production teacher prefixes are multiples of sixteen; this is a documented domain limit rather than a finding.

rebuild_asian_cache retains scalar/threshold/block summaries and explicit driver bindings, not N-by-threshold sample arrays across Cartesian nodes. replay_teacher does allocate node samples transiently.
Shared slice hashes/global mapping are provenance declarations; earlier random-driver values remain unverified, as the module says.

check_cash financial accounting is independently recomputed with event recurrence and discounted gains, including initial/interim/final costs and one claim settlement. Its boundary-level verification does not certify policy/market accuracy.
teacher/cache/market qualification stays unknown; statistics qualification is conditional on the externally measured envelope and uses saved indices without RNG.
